All-Clad is an American cookware manufacturer founded in 1971 in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania. The company is known for producing high-quality stainless steel pots and pans using a bonded metal construction process, where layers of different metals (typically stainless steel and aluminum, sometimes with copper) are fused together.

This multi-layer design combines the benefits of each metal—stainless steel for durability and a non-reactive cooking surface, aluminum or copper for excellent heat conductivity and even distribution.

All-Clad cookware is considered a premium brand, popular among both professional chefs and home cooks, though it carries a higher price point than many competitors. The company is now owned by Groupe SEB, a French housewares conglomerate.
